name: EGO
label: EGO
summary: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints the EGO CS1400, CS1401 and CS1804 on their own lines. CS1400 and CS1401 share a 14″ .043″ loop. CS1804 is an 18″ .050″ loop. The guide does not print a file size. The CS1600 and CS1604 are a later 16" saw from EGO's own manual, Oregon 90PX056X, and they are not the CS1400 loop.
